_comment: Gemma-only smoke: 12 conditions x 4 cases = 48 runs, ~45min. Exists so the arm that has never completed a case can be proven end to end without paying for a 3h eight-arm smoke. Verify with smoke_check.py --expected-conditions 12.
_seed_rationale: shuffle=true because limit takes rows[:N] and the first five testset entries are all order-management.json. Seed 12116 is a coverage device, not a measurement: its first four shuffled entries span four distinct logs INCLUDING bpic2017-ocel2.json, the 2.2 GB log most likely to fail on time or memory, at the lowest gold-execution cost of any seed satisfying that (40k seeds searched). The project seed 3407 covers four logs but misses bpic2017 entirely.
max_result_file_gb_note: Refuse to parse a prediction's result export larger than this. Parsing loads the whole file at once and an over-selecting query then SIGKILLs the shard -- uncatchable. Shard 60 of the matrix died this way three times (64GB 2026-08-21, 122GB 2026-08-25, 122GB 2026-08-27). Lowered 8 -> 4 on 2026-08-27: in the third run, exports of 10.48/10.72/10.74s PARSED at 122GB while an 11.59s export did not, which puts the real multiplier near 20x rather than the 11.7x measured on gold-shaped data -- at 11.7x those files would have been ~10GB and the 8GB cap would have fired. At 20x, 4GB projects to ~80GB (fits 122GB) and still exceeds the 64GB the other 95 shards had, so the cap remains provably inert for them. Every export above 256MB is now logged with its true size; set this from measurement, not from the multiplier.
